{
  "reasoning": "The model was asked to perform two parallel tasks: sum multiples of 3 and 5, and find the product of first five primes. The evaluation failed due to wrong function count—only one function was called instead of two, and the function name used an incorrect format.",
  "error_identification": "Turn 0: Function name used underscore separator (math_toolkit_sum_of_multiples) instead of dot notation (math_toolkit.sum_of_multiples), and Turn 1: product_of_primes function call is entirely missing. The model made only 1 call instead of the required 2 parallel calls.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model appears to have used an incorrect naming convention for the tool (underscore instead of dot notation) and failed to recognize that the user request explicitly requires two independent parallel operations. The second task about prime products was not invoked at all.",
  "correct_approach": "For parallel_multiple scenarios, invoke all required functions in a single turn using correct dot-notation naming (math_toolkit.sum_of_multiples and math_toolkit.product_of_primes). Both functions should be called simultaneously to satisfy the parallel execution requirement.",
  "key_insight": "Parallel task requests demand complete function enumeration with proper tool naming conventions. The model must parse multi-part user queries and execute all requested operations in one turn, not selectively execute only the first task."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".

  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
